chronoseries.order_note: Comparative extant series, not a stratigraphic succession. All three species are Holocene (0 Ma).

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg (1979): f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
equations.onset_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
equations.growth_rate: sigma(k) = 0.5 * (tr(M) + sqrt(tr(M)^2 - 4 det(M))), M = J - k^2 D
turing_conditions: (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)^2 > 4 D_u D_v det(J)

focal_suzukii.note: D_u is solved so the onset wavelength equals the assigned 2.046 µm detail scale. These are not measured yellow/ebony diffusivities.

predecessor_subobscura.interpretation: Obscura-group cuticle at this scale stays below activator autocatalysis, so no 2.046 µm carrier is selected.

successor_takahashii.interpretation: Same 24.552 µm window holds 10 onset wavelengths instead of 12. Hypothesis: weaker cortical tethering where the suzukii/biarmipes spot enhancer is absent.

ablation_equal_diffusion.expectation: D_v f_u + D_u g_v < 0, Turing band absent, activator variance collapses.

what_changes_at_this_scale.versus_predecessor: f_u changes from negative (subobscura, no real positive sigma) to positive (suzukii), which is what lets k_c select a 2.046 µm carrier. The 98 µm sibling slot is about the whole wing-spot domain; this slot is the carrier inside melanized cuticle.
what_changes_at_this_scale.versus_successor: Onset wavelength lengthens from 2.046 µm to 2.4552 µm (diffusivities × 1.44). Ocellus count in a 24.552 µm transect drops from 12 to 10.
what_changes_at_this_scale.age: 0 Ma for the focal species. Predecessor and successor are also extant; nothing in this slot is a fossil time series.

empirical_claims.claim: Male D. suzukii carries an apical dark wing spot; the female has a serrated, fruit-penetrating ovipositor.
The male wing spot of the suzukii–biarmipes clade is gained by a cis-regulatory change at yellow, not by a new pigment gene.
empirical_claims.source: Gompel et al. 2005; Prud'homme et al. 2006

empirical_claims.claim: Wing-pigment diversity across Drosophila, including spot presence and absence among suzukii, biarmipes and related subgroups, is reviewed as cis-regulatory evolution.
A two-morphogen system can be stable without diffusion and unstable at a finite wavenumber k_c.

not_empirical: No published measurement fixes the suzukii cuticle carrier at exactly 2.046 µm. That value is the campaign detail-scale assignment, used here as lambda_c.
D_u and D_v are calibrated to that assignment at diffusion ratio 12.6. They are not biochemical rates.
The takahashii 20% wavelength increase is a comparative hypothesis, not a measured granule spacing.

specimen.content: Male (apical wing spot) and female (serrated ovipositor, banded abdomen), lateral view, 1 mm scale bar
